title: San Francisco corrected some development fee postings years after the original charges

beats.text: A San Francisco park fee was shown under two different fiscal years across reports.

visual.sub: A park fee was transferred four fiscal years after its deposit

beats.text: The $25,000 payment came from a project on Pine Street.

visual.kicker: A park fee was transferred four fiscal years after its deposit

beats.text: It was collected in one fund and transferred to the right one four fiscal years later.
In child care, the General Fund was charged more than a million dollars by mistake.

visual.kicker: A child-care expenditure was charged to the General Fund

beats.text: The City corrected it fourteen fiscal years later. A later table shows the expense in its original year.

visual.heading: Child-care correction
visual.context: One original charge and one reimbursement

beats.text: At Rincon Hill, the City transferred $149,233 of interest from another fund.

visual.kicker: Interest credited to another fund was moved to Rincon Hill

beats.text: A different report put infrastructure revenue under affordable housing.

visual.kicker: A report assigned infrastructure revenue to affordable housing

beats.text: The corrected revenue exceeded four million dollars, plus separately identified interest.
The Controller documented corrections. Adding the old and corrected entries would count the same money twice.

visual.kicker: A report assigned infrastructure revenue to affordable housing
visual.text: How to read a restated account

beats.text: The dated journals would connect the original entries with their corrections.

visual.kicker: A report assigned infrastructure revenue to affordable housing
